prompt: A single complete powerful overhead fireball attack toward the right. Begin in boxing guard. Plant feet wider, bend knees, rotate shoulders and lift BOTH hands overhead. A dense blazing fireball grows between the raised hands, brighter and heavier as the boxer arches backward under its weight. Drive the entire torso forward, straightening the rear leg and swinging both arms from overhead down and forward to throw the huge fireball horizontally RIGHT. The fireball travels across the empty right half of the canvas and explodes near its right edge. Follow through with both arms extended right and torso leaning forward, then recover with controlled footwork and return to the original boxing guard. Clear anticipation, continuous full-body motion, weight transfer, explosive release, and recovery. Keep feet above the original baseline. Fixed camera, stationary canvas, no cuts, no zoom, no additional characters, no text.
